note: The HATVP does not publish a single headline net-worth figure. Press analyses of the patrimoine declarations of the Lecornu government (published 22 April 2026) placed Barrot among the wealthiest ministers, with assets of roughly EUR 4-5 million combining several inherited and acquired real-estate stakes, life-insurance policies (over EUR 1.6m at Crédit Agricole alone) and cash. This figure is a press estimate, not an official net figure, and is before deduction of his outstanding mortgage (EUR 310,971 remaining).
